summary: Elong Power Holding Ltd., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering of units comprising Class A ordinary shares, pre-funded warrants, and common warrants. The offering consists of up to 1,631,250 units at $1.30 each and 2,984,250 pre-funded units at $1.299 each, expecting gross proceeds of approximately $6 million. The common warrants have an exercise price of $1.30 per share, a three-year term, and include down-round anti-dilution provisions. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; no board recommendation or advisor is noted. Watch for dilution impact on existing shareholders.
